title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair — Episode5 Memories & Friendship

meta.Event Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Line: Shrine for the Performing Arts

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were actually in the same elementary school from first grade...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we hardly ever spoke since we were in different classes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, after Shii enrolled, she and Tsukasa's little sister, Saki, became best friends. I remember them going over to each others' houses quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And whenever Shii left something at Saki's house, Tsukasa would always bring it back for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We began talking more with each passing visit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see.
Shiho and Saki were essentially behind all this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's interesting how your siblings helped build your relationship.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Shizuku and I were in separate classes right through the sixth grade, so we didn't really play together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But now, we're good friends, with Saki acting as our liaison from time to time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki does mean the world to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, isn't that so sweet?
He always places her needs first!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but he isn't nice only to her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He's always been cheerful, energetic and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An incredibly kind friend.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Tsukasa, do you remember what happened when we were fourth graders?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
When we were fourth graders?
Hmmm... What happened back then?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were at the park one time and everyone got into an argument over whether I should play tag or hide and seek...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember!
The girls wanted you to play tag with them, but the boys demanded that you play hide and seek.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Children squabble over the silliest things.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, what ended up happening?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa just happened to be passing by and stepped in to help.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, what are you all arguing about?!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Tag or hide and seek? Is that what this is about?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmmm... I know!
This is the perfect time to do...a show!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Just bear with me!
It'll be titled...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is how we ended up doing a show called “Tagland & Hidenseekia”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Tagland and...?
What was it about exactly?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's the tale of how a wandering traveler brokers a peace agreement between the rivaling nations of Tagland and Hidenseekia.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds intriguing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When I first proposed the idea, everyone booed me for not choosing between tag or hide and seek and rattling on about this “show” business...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, after I began performing, they quickly followed suit. Through my show, we all had a chance to play both games!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, Tsukasa said how he was glad my friends and I were also able to come to an understanding...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was when I realized just how much you care about your friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
You give me far too much credit!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you're so cheerful, brave, quick-witted...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, go on!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Patient, honest... And so hard-working that you stayed after school to practice doing back hip circles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-Now I'm starting to feel embarrassed. Especially about that last part...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What's this?
Even Tsukasa can feel embarrassed over being complimented?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Show me a little humanity, will you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, she's right...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He cares deeply about his friends.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, Rui, congratulations!
I hope you and your new friends have a fun trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've made some wonderful new friends, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa doesn't stand to benefit from me becoming friends with some of my classmates...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(No, wait...
That's the wrong way to look at it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Seeing that his friends are happy in turn makes him happy.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
As fun as this conversation has been, the time for the parade is fast approaching! We should get going!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Agreed.
I'll let Miyake and the others know that we'll be making our way over.
Hyakki Yako Parade Venue

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Look at this crowd!
Try to stick close, okay, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right! I'll be right behind you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You two said you're trying to meet with Kamishiro's friends. Do you think you'll be able to find them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe so.
Based on this message, they should be...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, there you all are.
I'm glad we found you so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Yeah! I mean, this crowd's huge!
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro, those girls behind you. Aren't they...?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Yeah, they look familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Is it just me or is that Shizuku Hinomori...? And Airi Momoi? Who're they with? She's really pretty...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, they're friends of Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We bumped into each other earlier and decided to invite them to see the parade with us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you must be the friends they were talking about. It's nice to meet you. My name is Shizuku Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing the parade with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
T-Tenma...!
You're amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did I do something?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
...!
I-I-I-It's our pleasure! Albeit for a short while!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that you've had a chance to introduce yourselves, let's find a place with a good view!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right.
Shall we, everyone?
